headline: Citius Oncology Reports 120% Surge in LYMPHIR Wholesaler Sales
summary: Citius Oncology reported a 120% jump in wholesaler sales for its flagship product LYMPHIR.
why: Significant sales growth for core pharmaceutical products directly impacts biotech valuations and revenue projections.

impacts.name: Citius Oncology Inc
impacts.why: A substantial jump in wholesaler sales indicates stronger commercial adoption of its cancer therapy.

why_moved: A reported 120% jump in commercial wholesaler sales signals accelerated revenue growth for the company's key drug.
